title: Paperless-NGX Document Lifecycle Architecture & Dual-Store Ingestion Engine
summary: Architectural distillation of Paperless-NGX (v3.1.3), a production document management system. Documents the multi-stage ingestion pipeline (consumer.py), pluggable parser system, file locking invariants (FileLock/ReadWriteLock), Celery asynchronous worker queue, post-consumption workflow engine, and real-time WebSocket status telemetry.

references.description: Document consumer pipeline and stage coordinator
Document, Tag, Correspondent, DocumentType, and CustomField models
StatusConsumer ASGI WebSocket for progress telemetry

claims.claim: The consumer coordinates a 9-stage pipeline: pre-check duplicates, ASN uniqueness, pre-consume script, pluggable parser execution (OCRmyPDF/Tika), ML classification, unique filename generation, storage write, post-consume script, and workflow triggers.
Concurrency safety during document ingestion and index updates is guaranteed by filelock FileLock and ReadWriteLock instances wrapping storage directories and vector indices.
Client communication and UI telemetry is decoupled into 25+ DRF ViewSets under api/ with real-time asynchronous task progress piped through Channels WebSocket ws/status/.
